A Python interface to the RTE+RRTMGP Fortran software package.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyrte_rrtmgp
  version: "0.2.5"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/earth-system-radiation/pyRTE-RRTMGP/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 1cb2b7d50c0a34c0de679405fbe6ec7e40a143bd3cb509681ad3a326ca1cca12

build:
  number: 0
  skip: win or match(python, "<3.11") or match(python, ">3.14")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy >=1.21.0
        - pybind11 >=2.10.0
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake >=3.18
    - git >=2.44.0
    - libuv >=1.44.2
    - ninja >=1.10
    - python
  host:
    - numpy >=1.21.0
    - pip
    - pybind11 >=2.10.0
    - python
    - rte_rrtmgp ==1.9.2
    - scikit-build-core
  run:
    - netcdf4 >=1.7.2
    - numpy >=1.21.0
    - pytest >=7.4
    - pytest-cov >=3.0
    - python
    - requests >=2.4.0
    - rte_rrtmgp ==1.9.2
    - xarray >=2023.5.0
    - dask >=2023.5.0
    - scipy >1.0.0
    - numba >=0.64.0
    - molmass >=2025.12.12

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyrte_rrtmgp
      pip_check: false
  - requirements:
      run:
        - netcdf4 >=1.7.2
        - numpy >=1.21
        - pytest >=7.4
        - pytest-cov >=3.0
        - requests >=2.4.0
        - rte_rrtmgp ==1.9.2
        - xarray >=2023.5.0
        - dask >=2023.5.0
        - scipy >1.0.0
        - numba >=0.64.0
        - molmass >=2025.12.12
    script:
      - pyrte_rrtmgp run_tests

about:
  summary: A Python interface to the RTE+RRTMGP Fortran software package.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/earth-system-radiation/pyRTE-RRTMGP
  documentation: https://pyrte-rrtmgp.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - brendancol
    - giancastro
    - makepath-alex
    - RobertPincus
